body:
Next native Serenity slice: layered drifting cloud shadows, highlight bloom, water absorption, screen-space GI.

Sky and ground now march the same SerenityCloudNoise field (t=6, step 11) with shared time on sky.sunColor.w / serenityControls[6].z. BLOOM_THRESHOLD plus two extra Kawase rings stand in for a mip chain. Water mixes Beer-Lambert absorption from reconstructed thickness. Bounce reconstructs world positions and cosine-weights 16 taps.

Still gaps: voxel LPV volume, GPU histogram, true bloom mips, closest-velocity motion vectors. Cube Test fully relinked. Forge not touched.
